analysis.title: GS TMT TODAY 10.9.26
key_insights: Futures bounced (Nasdaq +75bps, S&P +40bps) as AI worries eased after OpenAI said it expects to reach or exceed $70bn in annualized revenue by year end. OpenAI said the confusion over yesterday's revenue figure largely reflects differences in how OpenAI and Anthropic calculate comparable revenue.

SPCX rose 4% after announcing it acquired low-band (800 MHz) spectrum that would let Starlink satellites make it a major US mobile carrier. A Musk post on X also described a path to SpaceX being worth orders of magnitude more than the current Earth economy.
On the SpaceX spectrum news, incumbent carriers traded lower premarket (TMUS, T, VZ all about -7%) and towers traded higher (CCI, SBAC about +7-8%).
AAPL fell 2% on a report that it cut component orders for the iPhone 18 Pro after weaker than expected demand. SWKS fell 1% as a read-across.
LITE rose 6.5% after saying its optical components are completely sold out through early 2029, lifting the optical group.

The GS desk saw a heavy wave of selling in Semis, AI and Megacap tech (over $1bn net supply) after the midday OpenAI headlines. This morning's snapback is another example of the high-velocity sentiment swings that have become a feature of AI investing and have contributed to choppy price action in recent months.

GIR views the SpaceX 800 MHz acquisition as negative for US telecom and positive for US towers. It sees SpaceX as a medium-term threat to wireless subscriber share, with some success likely among Starlink broadband customers in a bundled offering.

GIR notes the likelihood of SpaceX securing an MVNO increases as it makes progress. Next catalysts to watch are tower lease agreements for the 800 MHz band, the April 2027 Upper C Band auction, and a proposed auction of 25 MHz of mid-band spectrum (1,675-1,695 MHz and 2,020-2,025 MHz).

Channel checks suggest the 800 MHz band would be deployed on towers in metropolitan and urban areas as a coverage layer, with later densification through tower-based Upper C Band and femtocell deployments.
Bloomberg reports OpenAI expects to reach or exceed $70bn annualized revenue by end of 2026, driven largely by enterprise. Annualized revenue was roughly $50bn at the end of September.

Lumentum CEO said some products cannot meet about 70% of demand through next year and 30% of demand for other products through 2028. Six months ago he said capacity was on track to sell out by 2028. Nvidia invested $2bn in Lumentum earlier this year, alongside Coherent. Analysts expect Lumentum sales to more than double this year.

Nikkei reports Apple told suppliers to cut iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max component orders for October by at least 15%, with premium model orders down 15%-20%. Soaring memory chip costs forced price increases that dampened consumer demand.
Puck reports Netflix is preparing layoffs of about 5% of employees (about 850 of roughly 17,000), possibly announced as early as next week.

GS Dell investor field trip (Buy): neocloud AI server demand remains durable and Dell's moat extends beyond component access. Memory is expected to remain the key gating factor for AI infrastructure growth in 2027, with demand growth outpacing supply growth.
Dell: storage attach, increasing penetration of Dell IP and operating leverage should drive strong margins even with greater AI server mix (about mid-single-digit % range).

Macro setup: E-minis +35bps, Nasdaq futures +75bps, US 10-year yield higher at 5.25%, Brent -1.5%. SMH +1.5% and DRAM +2%. US data today: U of Michigan Consumer Confidence and Inflation Expectations at 10am, Fed President Collins at 4pm, DAL reports pre-open.

tension_points.bull_case: Towers benefit as the 800 MHz band is deployed on urban towers, with AMT +5%, CCI +7% and SBAC +4% after hours. SpaceX may find some success among Starlink broadband customers in a bundled offering.
tension_points.bear_case: Carriers (T, VZ, TMUS) fell 6-7% on the threat to wireless subscriber share. GIR notes SpaceX still needs several steps to compete, and that the threat is medium-term and depends on buildout and customer acquisition.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Tower lease agreements supporting the 800 MHz deployment and progress toward an MVNO are the catalysts to watch, as is the April 2027 Upper C Band auction.
